page.overview:
What is Cannon Arm?

The Cannon Arm is a device worn and used by Guts. While in its base state it functions as a prosthetic arm, it can double up as a miniature cannon. It has proven its usefulness several times in battle as a secondary weapon next to the Dragon Slayer.

The device was made by Rickert out of various materials he came across in Godot's warehouse. According to Erica, she helped in creating it as well. Rickert gave it to Guts as a farewell gift before he left for his two-year revenge against the apostles. It replaces Guts' left forearm, which he lost during the Eclipse. The hand hides a small magnet in order to better handle the Dragon Slayer, and above all it hides a cannon that many times saved the life of the Black Swordsman. The hand swivels downward to expose the barrel of the cannon.

The cannon arm resembles a miniature cannon or a large-bore musket. Its firing mechanism consists largely of a lit match, making it a match-lock firearm. The weapon is hidden behind the prosthetic hand, but a simple flick of Guts' artificial wrist puts the entire hand in a folding position, allowing him to fire the cannon.

Guts operates the cannon by loading powder into the barrel and ramming the cannonball into the barrel with a special ramrod. Guts then pulls a rope/cord that pulls his mechanical hand below the barrel which then leads to the powder igniting and then firing. Guts makes use of this cord in situations where he cannot let go of the Dragon Slayer or he can't use his right hand by pulling the cord with his teeth and firing the cannon that way.
